title: Contribution Ledger
description: VERIFY-stage producer artifact. Output of contribution-ledger-builder. Enumerates the paper's claimed contributions and binds each to evidence artifacts and the experimental condition that proves it. check_contribution_binding.py refuses a contribution with empty evidence_refs or no condition_id (unbound contribution).

contributions.description: list of claimed contributions; each must be bound to evidence and a condition

claim_text.description: the contribution claim as stated in the paper or manuscript

evidence_refs.description: non-empty list of artifact refs that provide evidence for this contribution; check_contribution_binding.py BLOCKs if empty

condition_id.description: non-empty id of the experimental condition that demonstrates this contribution; check_contribution_binding.py BLOCKs if empty/missing

scope_note.description: optional note on the scope or limitations of this contribution claim

run_ref.description: reference to the run whose evidence supports these contributions

ledger_notes.description: optional notes on the ledger as a whole (e.g. what was excluded and why)
